title: Minimum Path Sum
inputFormat: Implement minPathSum(grid). Receive a nonempty rectangular matrix of nonnegative integers. You may modify grid while computing the answer.
outputFormat: Return the minimum sum along a top-left to bottom-right path, including both endpoint values.
